shortDescription: Al Habtoor Group LLC is a prominent UAE conglomerate operating in hospitality, automotive, real estate, education, and publishing.
whatTheyDo: Al Habtoor Group manages luxury hotel properties, operates major automotive dealerships via Al Habtoor Motors, develops commercial and residential real estate projects including Al Habtoor City, and runs vehicle leasing and private education institutions in the UAE.
address: 727 Al Wasl Road, Al Safa 2, P.O. Box 25444, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Downtown, but corporate headquarters is located at 727 Al Wasl Road, Al Safa 2, Dubai (with major developments including Al Habtoor City situated near Business Bay and Downtown Dubai).

shortDescription: Al Mal Capital PSC is a regulated investment firm based in Dubai and a majority-owned subsidiary of Dubai Investments PJSC.
whatTheyDo: Al Mal Capital PSC provides asset management, investment banking, corporate advisory, and capital markets services across the MENA region. The firm acts as the fund manager for Al Mal Capital REIT, which is listed on the Dubai Financial Market.
address: Office 901, 48 Burj Gate, Sheikh Zayed Road, Downtown Dubai, P.O. Box 119930, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as DIFC, but Al Mal Capital PSC is headquartered at 48 Burj Gate on Sheikh Zayed Road in Downtown Dubai and is regulated by the UAE SCA.

shortDescription: Almarai is the Middle East's largest dairy, food, and beverage manufacturing and distribution company.
whatTheyDo: Almarai produces and distributes dairy products, baked goods, poultry, fruit juices, and infant nutrition across the GCC region. In the UAE, it operates extensive logistics, sales, and supply chain facilities to serve retail and food service customers.
address: Al Marai Emirates Company, Dubai Industrial City (Saih Shuaib 2), Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as JLT, but Almarai's corporate headquarters is in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and its primary Dubai operations and depot are in Dubai Industrial City, not JLT.

shortDescription: Al Masraf (Arab Bank for Investment and Foreign Trade) is a UAE-based financial institution offering commercial, corporate, and Islamic banking services.
whatTheyDo: Al Masraf provides corporate and commercial banking, trade finance, treasury services, retail banking, and Sharia-compliant Islamic banking products. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi, it serves institutional and individual clients through a branch network across the UAE.
address: Al Masraf Tower, Baniyas Street, Deira, P.O. Box 5549, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: Central Bank of the UAE Directory

notes: Input listed area as Dubai Internet City, but Al Masraf (Arab Bank for Investment and Foreign Trade) is headquartered in Abu Dhabi and its primary Dubai branch and tower is located on Baniyas Street in Deira.

shortDescription: Al Naboodah Group Enterprises LLC is a leading Emirati family-owned conglomerate operating across civil engineering, construction, automotive, and commercial trading.
whatTheyDo: Al Naboodah Group Enterprises oversees core divisions including Al Naboodah Construction Group (heavy civil infrastructure, MEP, building construction) and commercial businesses spanning automotive distribution, logistics, electrical products, and travel services across the UAE.
address: Al Awir 800, Dubai–Hatta Road (E44), P.O. Box 80657, Dubai, UAE

sources.title: PitchBook Profile - Al Naboodah Group Enterprises

notes: Input listed area as Downtown, but corporate headquarters is located at Al Awir 800 on the Dubai–Hatta Road (E44).

shortDescription: Al Rostamani Group is a major UAE conglomerate operating in automotive, building services, real estate, technology, and financial services.
whatTheyDo: Al Rostamani Group operates across several core sectors in the UAE, including commercial vehicle distribution via United Diesel, foreign exchange and financial services through Al Rostamani Exchange, building materials, property leasing, and information technology infrastructure solutions.
address: The MAZE Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, P.O. Box 29046, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Business Bay, but corporate headquarters (The MAZE Tower) is located on Sheikh Zayed Road (DIFC / Trade Centre area). Distinct from AW Rostamani Group (AWR).

shortDescription: Al Safi Danone is a regional dairy and beverage producer originally founded as a joint venture between Saudi Arabia's Al Faisaliah Group and France's Danone.
whatTheyDo: Al Safi Danone manufactures and distributes dairy products, laban, and fresh yogurts under brands including Al Safi, Activia, and Danette. In Dubai, its commercial distribution operations were historically based out of Al Quoz Industrial Area.
address: Al Quoz Industrial Area 4, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as JLT, but Al Safi Danone's Dubai commercial footprint was located in Al Quoz Industrial Area 4. Standalone corporate website domain alsafidanone.com is inactive.

shortDescription: Alserkal Group is a UAE family conglomerate operating in environmental solutions, real estate, automotive trading, and arts and culture.
whatTheyDo: Alserkal Group manages environmental engineering and recycling facilities (including Envirol and Blue LLC), real estate development and facilities management, tyre and automotive distribution, and cultural ventures including Alserkal Avenue in Dubai.
address: Office 601, 6th Floor, Alserkal Building, Airport Road, Deira, P.O. Box 21333, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Dubai Internet City, but Alserkal Group is headquartered at Alserkal Building on Airport Road in Deira, Dubai.

shortDescription: Alshaya Group is a multinational retail franchise operator managing leading international retail, hospitality, and dining brands.
whatTheyDo: Alshaya Group manages franchise networks across the UAE and Middle East for global brands in fashion, food and beverage, beauty, and home furnishings, including Starbucks, H&M, Victoria's Secret, and The Cheesecake Factory.
address: Al Barsha 1, 316 Road, P.O. Box 1277, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Downtown, but corporate offices in Dubai are located at Al Barsha 1 (316 Road).

shortDescription: Albwardy Marine Engineering (operating as Albwardy Damen) is a UAE shipbuilding, ship repair, and marine engineering joint venture.
whatTheyDo: Albwardy Damen provides ship construction, vessel conversions, afloat repairs, diving, and drydocking services to the offshore, marine, and oil and gas sectors from its shipyards in Dubai Maritime City, Al Jadaf, Sharjah, and Fujairah.
address: Dubai Maritime City (DMC), P.O. Box 6515, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed area as Business Bay, but Albwardy Marine Engineering (now Albwardy Damen) has its primary shipyard and offices at Dubai Maritime City and Al Jadaf Docking Yard.
